info.name: Kletia Platform API
info.description:
Plan cross-network intents into a DAG of network-bound steps, get unsigned wallet-ready transactions, and verify execution from on-chain evidence. Kletia never holds keys. Networks are CAIP-2 ids, accounts CAIP-10, assets CAIP-19, amounts base-unit strings.

Tiers: public 30/min per IP, developer 300/min per key, operator 1200/min per key. Errors are `{ "error": { "code", "message", "issues"?, "hints"?, "docs"? }, "requestId" }` with codes from the catalog at GET /v1/errors; every response carries X-Request-Id. Keyed POSTs that create or change state accept `Idempotency-Key`. Agents can use the read-only MCP server at /v1/mcp.

## Using this collection

- `baseUrl` is `https://api.kletiaai.xyz` (Production) or `http://localhost:3001` (Local development).

- Public endpoints work with an empty `apiKey`. Issue a key with `POST /v1/keys` (Keys folder), then store it in an environment or vault variable named `apiKey`; never share a collection that contains a key.

- The `POST /v1/intents` requests plan with `dryRun=true`: nothing is stored and nothing is signed. Kletia never holds keys; signing happens in the user's wallet.

- Ids such as `intentId`, `webhookId` and `keyId` are collection variables. Copy them from responses.

- Webhook deliveries (Intent event delivery, Test delivery) are requests Kletia sends to you; see the OpenAPI `webhooks` section and [webhook verification](https://github.com/furkan3152/Kletia/blob/main/docs/platform/api-v1.md).

Generated from `docs/platform/openapi.json` (OpenAPI 3.1.0, API 1.0.0) by `tooling/generate-collections.mjs`. Do not edit by hand.

variable.description: API origin without a trailing slash. Use http://localhost:3001 for a local or self-hosted API.
Developer key (kl_dev_…) for keyed calls. Leave empty for the public tier. Keep keys in a Postman environment or vault, never in a shared collection.
An intent id: plan one without dryRun (a stored intent), or list your intents.
A step id from the intent's graph (s1, s2, ...).
A webhook id from registering or listing webhooks.
An API key id from issuing or listing keys.
A CAIP-10 account for the portfolio request.
Transaction hash (EVM) or signature (Solana) of a prepared step, for Submit.

item.name: Plan an intent into an IntentGraph: dry run, natural language

header.description: Replays the first response for a retry with the same key. Needs an API key; {{$guid}} makes a new key per send, so set a fixed value to test a replay.

request.description:
Natural-language `text` is compiled by a deterministic grammar; unsupported wording returns 422 INTENT_UNSUPPORTED with example phrases in `error.hints`. With `dryRun=true` the plan is quoted but not stored (200; Idempotency-Key is ignored). A repeated `clientReference` from the same API key returns the original intent (200). Honours `Idempotency-Key` (with an API key): a retry with the same key and request replays the stored response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`.

Works without a key (public tier); a key raises the rate limit.

item.name: Build wallet-ready transactions for a ready step

request.description:
Every transaction is sent (EVM) or fee-paid (Solana) by the step account. Sign and send them in order, then submit the references. A payload expires at `payload.expiresAt`; prepare again to re-quote. Never retried automatically: an `Idempotency-Key` header is refused with 400 IDEMPOTENCY_NOT_SUPPORTED.

Works without a key (public tier); a key raises the rate limit.

`POST /v1/intents/{id}/steps/{stepId}/prepare` · operationId `prepareStep` · [Platform API v1](https://github.com/furkan3152/Kletia/blob/main/docs/platform/api-v1.md)

item.name: Submit transaction hashes / signatures for on-chain verification

header.description: Replays the first response for a retry with the same key. Needs an API key; {{$guid}} makes a new key per send, so set a fixed value to test a replay.

request.description:
A reference advances the step only after Kletia observes it on-chain from the bound account. Same-network steps become `settled`; cross-network steps become `settling` until the settlement network reports the destination fill. References that are provably not this step's transactions are refused with 422 (REFERENCE_WRONG_SENDER, REFERENCE_WRONG_CHAIN, REFERENCE_MISMATCH, REFERENCE_STALE, REFERENCE_ALREADY_USED) and leave the step unchanged. References not yet visible on-chain are stored (`submitted`) and re-verified by refresh and the settlement poller; until one of them produces on-chain evidence, new references (e.g. after a wallet speed-up) replace them. Honours `Idempotency-Key` (with an API key): a retry with the same key and request replays the stored response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`.

Works without a key (public tier); a key raises the rate limit.

`POST /v1/intents/{id}/steps/{stepId}/submit` · operationId `submitStep` · [Platform API v1](https://github.com/furkan3152/Kletia/blob/main/docs/platform/api-v1.md)

item.name: Server-Sent Events stream of intent events

request.description:
Starts with `retry: 3000`, replays buffered events after `Last-Event-ID` (or `?since=`; the whole buffer when absent, or when the id is no longer buffered, so de-duplicate by event id), then streams live events. Each frame is `id: <event id>`, `event: <type>`, `data: <KletiaEvent JSON>`. A comment heartbeat is sent every 15 s and the stream ends after 30 minutes.

Works without a key (public tier); a key raises the rate limit.

`GET /v1/intents/{id}/events` · operationId `streamIntentEvents` · [Platform API v1](https://github.com/furkan3152/Kletia/blob/main/docs/platform/api-v1.md)

item.name: Webhooks
item.description: Signed event deliveries to your HTTPS endpoints, test deliveries and delivery logs.

request.description:
Requires an API key (set `apiKey`).

`GET /v1/webhooks` · operationId `listWebhooks` · [Platform API v1](https://github.com/furkan3152/Kletia/blob/main/docs/platform/api-v1.md)

header.description: Replays the first response for a retry with the same key. Needs an API key; {{$guid}} makes a new key per send, so set a fixed value to test a replay.

request.description:
At most 10 webhooks per key. Deliveries are signed with `Kletia-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<t>.<raw body>")>`; verify with verifyWebhookSignature from @kletia/core. Honours `Idempotency-Key` (with an API key): a retry with the same key and request replays the stored response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. The stored response (with the secret) is encrypted at rest.

Requires an API key (set `apiKey`).

`POST /v1/webhooks` · operationId `createWebhook` · [Platform API v1](https://github.com/furkan3152/Kletia/blob/main/docs/platform/api-v1.md)

item.name: Send a signed webhook.test event now

request.description:
Makes one synchronous delivery attempt of a `webhook.test` event (see the webhookTest webhook) with the same signing, network rules, 5 s timeout and no-redirect policy as real deliveries, records it in the delivery log and returns the outcome. Always 200 when the attempt was made, whatever the endpoint answered. Test deliveries never pause a webhook. At most 5 per minute per webhook.

Requires an API key (set `apiKey`).

`POST /v1/webhooks/{id}/test` · operationId `testWebhook` · [Platform API v1](https://github.com/furkan3152/Kletia/blob/main/docs/platform/api-v1.md)

Every attempt, drop and test delivery, newest first. Payloads and error text are never stored. Kept for 7 days (at most 1000 per webhook; 100 with in-memory storage).

Requires an API key (set `apiKey`).

`GET /v1/webhooks/{id}/deliveries` · operationId `listWebhookDeliveries` · [Platform API v1](https://github.com/furkan3152/Kletia/blob/main/docs/platform/api-v1.md)

item.name: Keys
item.description: Issue, list, rotate and revoke the API keys of your project.

item.name: List the keys of the caller's project

request.description:
Never returns secrets, only `last4`. Operator keys cannot be listed (409 KEY_NOT_MANAGEABLE); a secret inside its rotation grace window cannot manage keys (403 KEY_SECRET_ROTATED).

Requires an API key (set `apiKey`).

`GET /v1/keys` · operationId `listApiKeys` · [Platform API v1](https://github.com/furkan3152/Kletia/blob/main/docs/platform/api-v1.md)

header.description: Replays the first response for a retry with the same key. Needs an API key; {{$guid}} makes a new key per send, so set a fixed value to test a replay.

request.description:
The key is shown once and stored only as a SHA-256 hash. Without a key this starts a new project; with a developer key the new key joins the caller's project (at most 5 active keys, else 409 KEY_LIMIT_REACHED). Limited to 5 keys per hour per IP. Honours `Idempotency-Key` (with an API key): a retry with the same key and request replays the stored response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. The stored response is encrypted at rest.

Works without a key (public tier); a key raises the rate limit.

`POST /v1/keys` · operationId `createApiKey` · [Platform API v1](https://github.com/furkan3152/Kletia/blob/main/docs/platform/api-v1.md)

header.description: Replays the first response for a retry with the same key. Needs an API key; {{$guid}} makes a new key per send, so set a fixed value to test a replay.

request.description:
Issues a new secret for an active key of the caller's project. The key id is unchanged, so intents, webhooks and usage stay attached. The previous secret keeps authenticating for `graceSeconds` (default 24 h, at most 7 days, 0 = stop now) but cannot manage keys; rotating again ends an earlier grace window. Other instances notice within 15 s. Honours `Idempotency-Key` (with an API key): a retry with the same key and request replays the stored response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. The stored response is encrypted at rest and replayed only to the current secret or to the secret that made the request (a key that rotated itself can retry with its old secret during the grace window); any other rotated-out secret gets 403 KEY_SECRET_ROTATED.

Requires an API key (set `apiKey`).

`POST /v1/keys/{id}/rotate` · operationId `rotateApiKey` · [Platform API v1](https://github.com/furkan3152/Kletia/blob/main/docs/platform/api-v1.md)

item.name: Revoke a key of the caller's project

request.description:
Idempotent. The key stops authenticating at once on the answering instance and within 15 s everywhere. A key may revoke itself. Its webhooks and their delivery logs are deleted and its intents' events are no longer delivered; repeating the call finishes a cleanup that failed (503).

Requires an API key (set `apiKey`).

`DELETE /v1/keys/{id}` · operationId `revokeApiKey` · [Platform API v1](https://github.com/furkan3152/Kletia/blob/main/docs/platform/api-v1.md)

item.description: Per-key request counts and rate-limit state.

item.name: Requests, status classes and intents of the caller's key

request.description:
Counts every request made with the key, by hour, route and status class (flushed every 30 s), plus the live rate-limit window of the answering instance and the intents the key created in the window.

Requires an API key (set `apiKey`).

item.name: MCP
item.description: Read-only Model Context Protocol server for agents.

item.name: Model Context Protocol server (Streamable HTTP): tools/list

request.description:
MCP revision 2026-07-28, plus stateless serving of 2025-era clients that open with `initialize`. Send one JSON-RPC message per request with `Accept: application/json, text/event-stream`; batches are refused and GET answers 405 (no server-initiated stream). Tools, all read-only: `list_networks`, `list_protocols`, `list_assets`, `get_quote`, `plan_intent`, `get_intent`, `list_intents`, `get_portfolio`, `create_signing_link`. No tool prepares, signs or submits a transaction; `create_signing_link` returns a Studio link (text up to 500 characters) for the user to sign with their own wallet. An API key maps to the MCP auth info (`clientId` = key id). Requests with an `Origin` header must come from an HTTPS origin (or localhost in development), else 403 MCP_ORIGIN_FORBIDDEN. Add it to Claude Code with `claude mcp add --transport http kletia https://api.kletiaai.xyz/v1/mcp`.

Works without a key (public tier); a key raises the rate limit.

`POST /v1/mcp` · operationId `mcp` · [Platform API v1](https://github.com/furkan3152/Kletia/blob/main/docs/platform/api-v1.md)
